caption: We asked Piper, the page assistant, for a landing page for a made up plumber. It built the page in 61.4 seconds for 850 credits, with three numbered promises written for us.
The billing portal says the trial ends on Nov 26, 2026 and then charges EUR 49.00 a month: EUR 40.50 plus EUR 8.50 tax.
Starting the trial booked a first payment of EUR 0.00 on our card on Nov 19, 2026, so a card is on file from day one. The card digits and transaction ID are hidden.

Cancelling takes three steps. The last one offers 50% off for 3 months, EUR 24.50 instead of EUR 49.00, with Take offer as the big button and Cancel subscription as a plain text link. We did not click either.
